note: ⛔ SNG-486. Ki Wield — Body's capstone, and the first Body craft to name the tradition's own power source.

abilities.name: Ki Wield
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing is drawn and nothing is worn. The air around the hands goes hard and slightly wrong, the way heat does over stone, and then a man in full plate is on his back with a hole in it.
abilities.description: Draw the body's own force out past the skin and wear it — as edge, as bolt, as armour — and it goes through what stops steel.
abilities.notFor: Anyone who has not mastered their own body; being worn while unconscious; anything you do not have the breath left to hold.

success.text: Edge, bolt and armour arrive at once and the exchange ends inside a breath.

failure.text: The force turns at the skin and spends itself in you.

bounds.text: ⛔ IT COSTS BREATH CONTINUOUSLY. Energy drains each round it is held, and when it runs out it drops mid-exchange
⚠️ THE WIELDER IS THE SOURCE — a body already spent has nothing to draw
one form at a time: edge, bolt, or armour. Changing form costs the action
it pierces RESISTANCE, not distance — a wall is still a wall

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action that deals damage. It rolls 4d6. Ranks: rank 2 fires it at range, rank 3 wears it as armour and holds all three at once.

sectFlavour.somatic: THE PERFECTED VESSEL SPENDING ITSELF — what the Flesh-Temples train toward and rarely reach.
sectFlavour.mason: ⚠️ Not this craft. A mason picks up something heavy.

tree.name: Ki Edge
tree.grants: ⛔ ARM YOURSELF IN KI. Hands, feet or a held weapon carry the body's force past the skin — and it PIERCES RESISTANCE: armour, hide, soak and craft-resistances all count for far less against it.
tree.cannot: Contact range. It costs breath every round it is held.
tree._imposes: ⛔ SNG-513. ⛔ Force past the skin, piercing resistance. A crit ends the exchange.

tree.name: Ki Bolt
tree.grants: ⛔ DEALS 4d6 DAMAGE AT RANGE. Loose a bolt of your own force from an open hand — it arrives as hard as the strike and PIERCES RESISTANCE the same way: armour, hide, soak and craft-resistances count for far less.
tree.cannot: One bolt per action, and each one costs more breath than a strike.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS RANGE. Throw it — a bolt of the same force, loosed from an open hand, arriving as hard as the strike and piercing the same way.

tree.name: Ki Wield
tree.grants: ⛔ DEALS 4d6 AND WEARS THE FORCE AS ARMOUR. Edge, bolt and armour held AT ONCE rather than chosen — the worn layer turns blows and crafts alike, and the strike still pierces resistance.
tree.cannot: One wielder, and all three forms are held together or not at all.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS ARMOUR AND SIMULTANEITY. Wear it as well — force held at the skin that turns blows and crafts alike — and hold edge, bolt and armour AT ONCE rather than choosing.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-486. Erik: 'I'm not feeling Pathless Way — cut. A BODY CAPSTONE SHOULD BE KI WIELD or something — ARM AND ARMOR YOURSELF IN KI. It PIERCES RESISTANCES, can be FIRED LIKE MAGIC BOLTS and can SHIELD you.'
⚠️ IT ALSO ANSWERS SOMETHING THE AUDIT FOUND: metaphysical is Body's power source — 'Veil/Psychic/KI type innate power' (SNG-445) — and NOT ONE BODY CRAFT NAMED KI. The tradition's own source was invisible in its own skill list.
⛔ AND IT IS THE COUNTER TO SHAPED BODY r3, which grants resistance to crafts. Ki Wield pierces resistance. The tradition now contains its own answer.
abilities._r3cost: ⚠️ SNG-487, Erik: 'No additional cost for r3.' The tripled drain is removed; the standing per-round breath cost from r1 still applies.

_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng513: ⛔ SNG-513: `imposes` and `ongoingHarm` authored. Both readers were live and unfed — CCode named the fields rather than authoring content. ⚠️ `onCrit` IS ESCALATE: a crit imposes a DIFFERENT, stronger condition. `slain` is refused at all three doors — a craft is not a situation.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
